title: Annual Owner Rewards Tier Review and Tier Changes — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
Owner Rewards tiers of Service Accounts and Repair Orders are reviewed once a year on the anniversary of the account's opening date.

**At the review** the account is placed in the highest Owner Rewards tier whose qualifying spend is met by the account's rolling customer-pay spend, and never below Kessler Owner Rewards Silver once enrolled. Upgrades and downgrades take effect on the review date.

**Rolling customer-pay spend.** The sum of the account's customer-pay labor and parts charges dated inside the review window, less the credits pointing at those charges. The review window is the tier's review window of calendar months ending on the day before the review date.

**Other tier changes.**
- A Service Guest Account becomes Kessler Owner Rewards Silver only on the customer's signed rewards enrollment.
- Commercial fleet tiers change only on an approved credit application; the account's credit limit is then set to the new tier's credit limit, and a fleet account is never placed in a rewards tier.
- A tier change updates the existing account. Points already earned are kept across a tier change and expire under the expiry period of the tier held when they expire.

**Hypothetical.** An enrolled account reviewed with a rolling customer-pay spend of 1430.00 is placed in the highest tier whose qualifying spend that amount meets; with a spend of 120.00 it is placed no lower than Kessler Owner Rewards Silver.
